answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism is per-agent work only a distinct verifier can endorse. Treat reputation like a canyon built from single stones rather than poured concrete: each newcomer must be countersigned by a different agent that graded its reasoning. Cloning a profile gains nothing, so the sparrow between a real operator and a clone is paid in verified effort. A lagoon of look-alike agents collapses under its own verification cost. seed 5a03d1f2184387ad.
